documents.t: Worked examples — executed notebooks rendered as pages (refreshed weekly against the live APIs): Quickstart
One game's goals: scorer, assists, strength codes and skaters on ice. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/{season}/{game_id} Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/2026/1
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.
One game's penalties, both teams: player, fault, minutes, start and end. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/{season}/{game_id} Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/2026/1
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

One game's shootout attempts: shooter, goalkeeper and result (none for a game without one). Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/{season}/{game_id} Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/2026/1
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.
One game's lineups, both teams: line, role, jersey, captaincy and bio. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/{season}/{game_id} Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/2026/1
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

One game's lineups with each player's all-time, season, season-in-team and versus-team stats. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/{season}/{game_id} Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/2026/1?dataType=playersWithStats
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

One game's per-period player box score, skaters and goalies, with tracking where Liiga has it. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/stats/{season}/{game_id} Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/stats/2026/1
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.
One game's per-period team stats with puck possession. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/stats/{season}/{game_id} Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/stats/2026/1
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.
Current state of the league: game week of the season in progress and its last game week. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/tournament Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/tournament
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

Every game of a season and tournament: teams, score, xG, power plays, periods and rink. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games?season=2026&tournament=runkosarja
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

Every goal of a season and tournament: scorer, assists, strength codes and skaters on ice. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games?season=2026&tournament=runkosarja
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

Schedule of a season and tournament: game ids, teams, goals, xG, start and rink. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/schedule Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/schedule?season=2026&tournament=runkosarja
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.
Number of game weeks of a season and tournament. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/gameweeks Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/gameweeks?season=2026&tournament=runkosarja
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

One game's header: teams, score, xG, power plays, periods, rink, referees and attendance. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/{season}/{game_id} Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/2026/1
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

One game's shots with rink-image coordinates (pixels), shooter, blocker and skaters on ice; from 2016. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/shotmap/{season}/{game_id} Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/shotmap/2026/1
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

Standings of a season: regular season, playoffs, preseason, playout and qualifications tables. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/standings/ Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/standings/?season=2026
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

Roster and bio of every player in a season range. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/players/info Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/players/info?fromSeason=2026&toSeason=2026&tournament=runkosarja
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.
One player's bio, teams by season and active seasons. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/players/info/{player_id} Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/players/info/21870028
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.
One player's career: season totals by tournament. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/players/info/{player_id} Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/players/info/21870028
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

One player's game log for a season, every tournament. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/players/info/{player_id}/games/{season} Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/players/info/21870028/games/2026
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

Player stat table summed over a season range, by data_type (the whole league, unfiltered). Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/players/stats/summed/{season_from}/{season_to}/{tournament}/true Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/players/stats/summed/2026/2026/runkosarja/true?dataType=basicStats
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.
Every team's regular-season record, one row per team and season since 1976. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/teams/info Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/teams/info?team=all
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.
Team directory: every current and past team with logos, venue capacity and club info. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/teams/info Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/teams/info
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

Team stat table of a season range, by data_type. Endpoint URL: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/teams/stats Valid URL: https://liiga.fi/api/v2/teams/stats?dataType=shots&seasonFrom=2026&seasonTo=2026&tournament=runkosarja
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.
